summary: Sellbird, formerly Harvey, was the second AI climb on GitHub's Python trending list, with 358 stars today and about 6,500 in total. The project says it finds companies and decision makers, checks emails, writes a personal cold email, sends it, and handles replies, using your Claude or ChatGPT plan. It is AGPL-3.0.
